title: World's Smallest Violin
lyrics:
[00:00.58]My grandpa fought in World War II
[00:07.57]He was such a noble dude
[00:09.60]I can't even finish school
[00:11.72]Missed my mom and left too soon
[00:13.77]His dad was a fireman
[00:15.59]Who fought fires so violent
[00:17.63]I think I bored my therapist
[00:19.72]While playing him my violin
[00:22.02](Oh, my God) That's so insane
[00:24.06](Oh, my God) That's such a shame
[00:26.13]Next to them, my shit don't feel so grand
[00:30.20]But I can't help myself from feeling bad
[00:34.40]I kinda feel like two things can be said
[00:38.32]The world's smallest violin
[00:40.69]Really needs an audience
[00:42.42]So if I do not find somebody soon (That's right, that's right)
[00:46.64]I'll blow up into smithereens
[00:48.66]And spew my tiny symphony
[00:50.73]Just let me play my violin for you, you, you, you
[01:11.41]My grandpa fought in World War II
[01:13.55]And he was such a noble dude
[01:15.86]Man, I feel like such a fool
[01:17.95]I got so much left to prove
[01:20.00]All my friends have vaping friends
[01:22.05]They're so good at making friеnds
[01:24.10]I'm so scared of caving in
[01:26.15]Is that entertaining yеt?
[01:28.22](Oh, my God) That's so insane
[01:30.36](Oh, my God) That's such a shame
[01:32.36]Next to them, my shit don't feel so grand
[01:36.39]But I can't help myself from feeling bad
[01:40.56]I kinda feel like two things can be said
[01:44.52]The world's smallest violin
[01:46.87]Really needs an audience
[01:48.67]So if I do not find somebody soon (That's right, that's right)
[01:52.85]I'll blow up into smithereens
[01:54.88]And spew my tiny symphony
[01:56.95]Just let me play my violin for you, you, you, you
[02:17.84]Somewhere in the universe
[02:19.97]Somewhere someone's got it worse
[02:21.96]Wish that made it easier
[02:24.05]Wish I didn't feel the hurt
[02:25.91]The world's smallest violin
[02:28.17]Really needs an audience
[02:30.04]So if I do not find somebody soon
[02:34.81]I'll blow up into smithereens
[02:37.23]And spew my tiny symphony
[02:39.64]All up and down a city street
[02:41.76]While tryna put my mind at ease
[02:43.51]Like finishing this melody
[02:45.20]This feels like a necessity
[02:46.84]So this could be the death of me
[02:48.49]Or maybe just a better me
[02:50.10]Now come in with the timpanis
[02:51.61]And take a shot of Hennessy
[02:53.10]I know I'm not there mentally
[02:54.57]But you could be the remedy
[02:56.06]So let me play my violin for you
